articles.title: Nigerians should think twice before relocating abroad – UK defence official
articles.summary: Abimbola Oluwasona, a Senior Strategic Supply Chain Manager at the UK Ministry of Defence, was interviewed by BIODUN BUSARI. He discussed his career trajectory, experiences in voluntary services, and various issues relevant to Nigeria. This conversation offers aspirants insight into high-level strategic roles within international defence organisations and the broader impact professionals can have through their careers and volunteer work.

articles.title: 10 Times Superman Went Too Far in DC Comics
articles.summary: Superman stands as the moral compass of the DC Universe, symbolizing truth, justice, and the protection of the defenseless. His extraordinary powers demand immense responsibility, highlighting the profound ethical burden associated with wielding great capabilities. This portrayal underscores a commitment to societal ideals and safeguarding the vulnerable, reflecting universal principles of duty and protection.

articles.title: Lakers Dealt Great News As ‘Dream’ Trade Target Likely To Hit Open Market
articles.summary: A crucial foul occurred with just 0.09 seconds left in an NBA game at Intuit Dome. Los Angeles Clippers' Derrick Jones Jr. fouled Denver Nuggets' Jamal Murray on a three-point attempt. This highly impactful play likely determined the game's outcome between two major US teams, drawing significant attention within the national sports scene due to its decisive timing.
